improvement: When a prior project roster contains multiple source families, an English or French reported-end-date follow-up that explicitly names FONGIM, World Bank or EU now carries only that source family's identifiers into a fresh lookup. A generic mixed-source follow-up remains ambiguous and continues through semantic resolution instead of silently choosing or merging families.
reproduced_before: Explicit follow-ups such as 'Which of those FONGIM projects have a reported end date in 2026?' and 'Which of those World Bank projects end in 2027?' returned no structured resolution when the prior answer also mentioned another source family.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only source identifiers and the requested time constraint are carried. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and other source-family identifiers are excluded from the standalone question.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: A mixed roster without an explicitly named source family is not resolved deterministically.
qualification.api_guard: The explicit-source path skips semantic rewriting and invokes one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a signed-in Render dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test explicit English and French mixed-roster source selection, the generic ambiguity guard, prior catalogue and subset regressions, fresh citations, FONGIM selected ID 664, and Mali 815 to Gao 44.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue or mixed-source disambiguation fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only recognised reported-end-date follow-up wording and explicitly named source families use this deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
